prompt: A garden bed is shaped like a trapezoid with parallel sides of $14$ ft and $22$ ft. A hose is laid across the midsegment — the segment joining the midpoints of the two slanted sides. How long is that segment?
hint: The midsegment of a trapezoid is the AVERAGE of the two parallel sides.

hints.text: The midsegment of a trapezoid is the AVERAGE of the two parallel sides.
Average $14$ and $22$: add them, then halve.

explanation: The hose is $18$ ft long. Choice B.

alternativeExplanations.title: It has to land in between
steps: Halfway up the trapezoid, the width must be between $14$ and $22$ — and dead center between them, since it is halfway.
That instantly rules out $8$, $36$, and $11$; only $18$ sits midway.
